text:
samira: pitching a tighter benchmark narrative for launch — want to prioritize two audiences: infra/platform engineers and product/PMs. one hero visual, two CTA flows.

owen_k: great. visual idea? maybe a clean split: left shows latency distribution (median + p95), right shows unit-cost savings as relative % bands. keep OG friendly.

pat: for PMs we should surface small-seq fastpath (<64 tokens). add a tiny annotation: 'fast interactive path'.

nish: data from last run: median=54ms/token, p95=190ms/token, raw baseline=$0.26/1k, optimized=$0.085/1k. i'll upload CSV to /marketing/bench/bench_5349991234.csv by EOD.

samira: thanks. copy asks: short OG headline and longer blog subtitle. OG candidate: 'Predictable inference at scale.' blog subtitle: 'How we balance latency and unit cost across deployment modes.'

owen_k: OG maybe tweak to 'Predictable inference economics.' shorter and fits OG overlay. keep <60 chars.

samira: ok using owen_k's variant. growth-team: routing? want UTM bench_launch_q3_26; demo signups -> SDR-B; enterprise -> AE queue with tag 'bench-enterprise'.

growth-team: confirmed. we'll add hidden field `bench_segment=launch_q3` and set routing. also prepping a short SDR playbook with qualifying questions (latency vs cost priority, monthly token volume).

brand-bot: Design constraints: OG 1200x630px min, central text <60 chars, include alt text and one-line transparency footer.

pat: design notes: two figma variants — percent deltas vs absolute dollars. prefer percent in hero, dollar table in blog for detail.

owen_k: SEO note — include longtail keyword 'inference cost per token' in blog H2 and the CSV export for journalists.

nish: will add a README with run config and an explicit footer string: 'Tests run with open model X on standard GPU; results vary by workload.'

samira: webinar plan: 20m demo + 20m Q&A, plus a short ops playbook PDF. ask infra to demo fallback policies and cache effects.

pat: also create a one-slide 'how we measure' with exact batch sizes, quant settings, and hardware used. keep it in the public appendix.

owen_k: social copy variants: A) 'Latency you can rely on. Costs you can control.' B) 'Same models, lower inference bills.' A preferred.

samira: we'll A/B test A vs B in email subject lines. jamie from content to run the test.

brand-bot: Reminder: schedule webhook to notify #sdr when blog publishes; OG image must have alt text field filled.

growth-team: done — routing automation queued. we'll also tag lead rows with `bench_cohort=5349991234` for reporting.

samira: timeline: csv by nish EOD, figma comps by pat tomorrow 10am, hero copy by me by noon, blog target next Tue. flag changes to numbers immediately. thanks :rocket:
